ns2:course.label: Special Disciplines
ns2:course.description: Variable content course concentrating on an area such as comparative grammar, epigraphy, metrics, palaeography, or papyrology. Same as LAT 531. May be repeated if topics vary. Prerequisite: GRK 491 and LAT 491, or equivalent.
